candidates.description: The feature activates for substrings and characters associated with the names of Hindu deities, particularly Brahma and related mythological terms.
This vector is related to subword tokens and fragments of text in Hindi and other Indic scripts.
This vector represents the character 'ष' (ssa) and its various conjunct forms with vowel matras in the Devanagari script.
This vector activates for various vowel-sign combinations, syllables, and short words in Hindi and Devanagari script.
This vector activates on common Hindi character combinations and linguistic suffixes.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters alongside a capitalized English word fragment.
This vector represents common Hindi root words, verb stems, and inflectional suffixes.
These tokens represent common Marathi word endings, suffixes, or character sequences featuring the consonant 'र' (ra).
This vector activates strongly for Hindi words and sub-word tokens containing the Devanagari character 'ध' (dha) or its vowel-modified variants.
These tokens represent Hindi vowel sign matras attached to comma punctuation marks.
